unimod_text: You can query the PTMs in the Unimod website below

rt_correction_enabled_help: Green indicates RT Calibration is enabled
rt_correction_disabled_help: Gray indicates RT Calibration is disabled
rt_correction_description: RT Calibration is used to calibrate retention times  between different samples. Function Calibration has higher priority than constant offset.
rt_correction_function_help: Function Calibration has highest priority, such as: x + 0.5 or 1.2 * x, x stands for RT
rt_correction_offset_help: Constant offset used when no function is set
rt_correction_edit_description: Function Calibration has higher priority than constant offset
